messages:
sam: Quick lane check (2m) scope: marketplace onramp for partner GPUs (H100 image), H200 fallback, B200 burst SKU, MI300 pilot, Gaudi SI handoff. Need owners + any hard blockers.

olivia: I can coordinate cross-team owners and comms. Top current risk we saw: H100 partner image triggers cgroup memory alerts during continuous streaming >700 tokens. Filed PART-5512.

maria: Marketing constraint: need a 10-business-day embargo notice before any public announce. Can we lock a soft SI-only date so marketing drafts joint comms?

vikram: Infra: B200 burst validated but autoscaler mis-schedules under short spikes; filing ENG-9022. Gaudi SI VPN cert expires next week; scheduling rotation. Also H200 capacity is available for fallback.

elaine: Legal note: MI300 model bundle arrived but IP attestation missing. Legal will allow SI-only pilot with signed attestation + SI addendum. ETA for attestation expected in ~5 business days if partner has no redlines.

sam: Owners proposed: sam=H100 escalation & fallback plan, vikram=infra & autoscale, elaine=MI300 legal gating, olivia=announce coord & embargo. Any objections?

omit: (typo)

olivia: No objections. Proposed soft SI-only listing: 2025-05-20; GA target: 2025-06-03, both subject to gating items.

sam: H100 plan: escalate to vendor firmware team for memory leak traces; if vendor can't patch in 72h, fallback is to ship H200/B200 route and list H100 as "accel-limited" with a note. Also asking partner for cosign-signed image.

vikram: Autoscaler change proposal: min=4 max=20 burst=14 for marketplace route. I'll request a 30m maintenance window to roll config. For the VPN cert I'll post the schedule in infra channel. Filed ENG-9022 with scheduler traces.

elaine: MI300 runbook snippet for SI validation (short):
```
1) docker pull redwood/runtime:mi300-canary-2025-05
2) ./bench --model mi300-quant --seq 2048 --batch 2 --repeat 3 > mi300-si.log
3) attach mi300-si.log to PART-5518
```

maria: Marketing will draft embargo copy: "Joint marketplace listing subject to final QA and partner sign-off. Do not publish until notified." Will hold drafts until we get attestation and cosign verification.

deploy-bot: Staging publish queued for `marketplace/partner-batch-may-2025` 1) blockers: PART-5512 (H100 mem), PART-5518 (MI300 attestation), ENG-9022 (autoscale) 1) queued at 2025-05-10T09:00:00Z

sam: Summing actions: escalate H100 + request cosign (sam), run autoscale window (vikram), chase MI300 attestation (elaine), marketing draft + embargo (maria), reconvene Wed 9am PT. Post short updates in-thread only. :thumbsup:
